## Full-Stack Developer Transition: 6-Month Plan

This 6-month learning plan is designed for a junior software developer with 2 years of experience, based in Berlin, aiming to transition into a full-stack role focusing on Python/Django for the backend and React for the frontend. The plan assumes a dedication of 10-15 hours per week to self-study, starting December 1, 2023.

## 6-Month Full-Stack Learning Roadmap

This roadmap outlines key focus areas, learning tasks, and deliverables to guide your transition, building foundational knowledge month by month.

Month | Focus Area | Key Learning Tasks | Project/Deliverable
:---- | :--------- | :----------------- | :-----------------
**Dec 2023** | **Python & Django Fundamentals** | Deepen Python knowledge (decorators, generators); Understand Django MVT architecture, ORM, models, views, templates, URLs; Work with Django Admin. | Build a simple Django CRUD application (e.g., a task manager or blog).
**Jan 2024** | **Django REST APIs** | Learn Django REST Framework (DRF); Create serializers, viewsets, routers; Implement token-based authentication and permissions. | Extend your Django app with a RESTful API for external consumption.
**Feb 2024** | **React Frontend Basics** | Master JavaScript ES6+ features; Understand React components (functional & class), state, props, lifecycle methods; Implement React Router for navigation. | Develop a basic React frontend consuming data from a public API (e.g., a weather app or movie list).
**Mar 2024** | **React & Django Integration** | Connect React frontend to Django REST API using Axios/Fetch; Handle CORS policies; Implement user authentication (JWT) between frontend and backend. | Integrate your React frontend with the Django REST API from Month 2, creating a full-stack application.
**Apr 2024** | **Databases, Testing & Deployment** | Learn PostgreSQL basics and integrate with Django; Write unit and integration tests for both Django (Pytest) and React (Jest); Containerize your application with Docker; Explore basic cloud deployment (e.g., Render, Heroku). | Deploy your full-stack application to a cloud platform; Ensure basic test coverage.
**May 2024** | **Advanced Topics & Portfolio** | Explore advanced React state management (Context API, Redux Toolkit); Implement real-time features with WebSockets (Django Channels); Focus on performance optimization, security best practices; Build a substantial portfolio project. | Develop a new, more complex full-stack portfolio project from scratch; Update resume and LinkedIn profile.

## Key Learning Resources

Supplement your hands-on projects with official documentation and reputable learning platforms.

- **Official Documentation**:
  - Django: [Button: Read Docs] https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/stable/
  - Django REST Framework: [Button: Read Docs] https://www.django-rest-framework.org/
  - React: [Button: Read Docs] https://react.dev/
- **Online Courses/Platforms**:
  - Udemy/Coursera: Search for "Modern React with Redux", "Python and Django Full Stack Web Developer Bootcamp".
  - Frontend Masters: Offers in-depth React and JavaScript courses.
  - Test-Driven Development with Python (book): Excellent resource for Django testing.
- **Community & Practice**:
  - Participate in local developer meetups in Berlin.
  - Contribute to open-source projects on GitHub.
  - Solve coding challenges on platforms like LeetCode or HackerRank.

## Sources

- Django Documentation: https://docs.djangoproject.com/
- Django REST Framework Documentation: https://www.django-rest-framework.org/
- React Documentation: https://react.dev/
